title: FAIR² Certification Credential (fair2-cert.json)
description: A W3C Verifiable Credential (VC Data Model 2.0) asserting the FAIR² certification status of one exact package version. Referenced from the Certification pointer node inside fair2.json via fair2:certificationDocument. See docs/specification/certification.md.

@context.description: The VC 2.0 context first, then the FAIR² context.

issuer.description: The certifier's DID. Must appear in the authorised-certifier registry with authority spanning validFrom.

validFrom.description: Issuance date. Certifier authority is checked at this date, not at verification time.

validUntil.description: Not permitted. Decision C binds a certification to a package version, not to the calendar; it ends by revocation or by the package changing.

id.description: The certified dataset, by DOI URL. Matches the @id of the fair2.json.

certifiedDocument.description: URL of the exact fair2.json the digests were taken over. The metadata document, not a governance document of the same filename.

conformsTo.description: The FAIR² spec version validated against.

metadataVersion.description: fair2:metadataVersion of the certified document — the document's own version, not the dataset's.

digestMultibase.description: Multibase multihash (sha2-256) of the published bytes. Checked first.

graphDigestMultibase.description: Multibase multihash (sha2-256) of the RDFC-1.0 canonical n-quads. Checked only if the byte digest fails; a match means equivalent, not identical.

certificationScope.description: What was checked. A scope omitting dataIntegrity must be rendered as "FAIR²-Certified (metadata only)".

StatusListEntry.description: Revocation. There is no expiry to check.

verificationMethod.description: A method in the issuer DID document's assertionMethod.

Multibase.description: Multibase 'u' (base64url, unpadded) over a multihash. 0x12 0x20 is sha2-256.
